feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR National News for reporting across the United States. Explore coverage of economic affordability, immigration, climate, environmental policy, justice and social trends.

entry.title: Mississippi AG says use of force was 'justified' in fatal shooting of toddler
entry.summary: Mississippi's Attorney General says the use of force was justified when a toddler was killed during a police shooting after a shoplifting.

entry.title: Russia releases imprisoned U.S. citizen Stephen Hubbard following Trump's request
entry.summary: The announcement of Hubbard's release came as talks got underway between Putin and White House envoy Steve Witkoff in Saint Petersburg focused on the latest U.S. efforts to end the war in Ukraine.

entry.title: 2025 policing trend: Fewer serious crimes, more minor arrests
entry.summary: Arrests for more minor offenses, including vagrancy, rose in the U.S., even as violent crime rates dropped to historic lows, according to an analysis from criminal justice reform advocacy group FWD.us

entry.title: FAA clears the way for airlines to put Boeing's long-delayed 737 Max 10 into service
entry.summary: Nearly a decade after Boeing unveiled its largest 737 Max jet, the company has cleared a major hurdle in its effort to bring the plane to airlines.

entry.title: United Nations report highlights significant increase in U.S. climate pollution
entry.summary: The U.S. is the only major economy where planet-warming pollution dramatically increased last year. The United Nations warns the planet is on track for catastrophic warming.

entry.title: Men speak out against sexual violence following Cornell rape story
entry.summary: The alleged gang rape at a Cornell University fraternity house has revived discussions on college campuses. We talked to some men who have been thinking and writing about this.

entry.title: Mississippi AG says officers did not use excessive force in toddler death
entry.summary: The Mississippi Attorney General says use of force was justified when a toddler died during a police shooting in June.

entry.title: Data center divides North Carolina county
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep visits the site of a future data center in Stokes County, North Carolina.

entry.title: 'There's a lot to be done': North Carolina continues recovery from Hurricane Helene
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep visits communities still recovering from Hurricane Helene two years later.

entry.title: North Carolina and Georgia are research hubs. How Trump's cuts have affected them
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep explores how the Trump administration's policies have impacted public health research in NC and GA.
